Evaluates the V17.9.3.1.2.2 Signal Intelligence stage inside `SharedStrategyEvaluator`.
Enforces:
  - Fail-closed rejection on invalid mode or policy ID.
  - Fail-closed rejection if `RESEARCH_APPLY` is invoked from Production/PAPER/LIVE adapter.

Section 03 & Section 04 (SI3):
Advances a `WAITING_CONFIRMATION` setup strictly forward in time across closed M1 bars
(`idx > start_bar_index`, `close_time <= pending.expires_at_ms`).
Never backdates entries:
  - If a bar gap (> 180s) occurs -> `CANCELLED_GAP`
  - If price breaches `invalidation_price` before confirmation -> `INVALIDATED`
  - If `close_time > expires_at_ms` -> `EXPIRED`
  - If a closed bar confirms displacement break / FVG retest -> rebuilds entry at that
    confirmation bar's close quote (to be filled at the NEXT bar's open bid/ask), re-runs
    `calculate_risk_reward()`, and returns `CONFIRMED` (or `INVALIDATED` if net RR < 2.0).
Returns `(updated_pending, confirmed_bar_index_or_None)`.

Computes a strictly pre-entry candidate quality tuple for multi-model arbitration (`SI1`, `SI6`).
NEVER reads post-entry WIN/LOSS outcome labels, MFE/MAE, or realized PnL.
Raises `ValueError` if a caller attempts to inject post-entry label arbitration (`M13` guard).

Section 04 (SI1/SI6):
Deterministically arbitrates competing eligible model candidates at the same M1 timestamp:
  - `STATIC_PRODUCTION_PRIORITY`: canonical production order (`REVERSAL` > `CONTINUATION` >
    `FVG_CONTINUATION` > `SWEEP_RECLAIM` > `CG01`).
  - `REVERSE_STATIC_PRIORITY`: reversed order (`CG01` > `SWEEP_RECLAIM` > `FVG_CONTINUATION` >
    `CONTINUATION` > `REVERSAL`).
  - `PRE_ENTRY_QUALITY_TUPLE`: ranks strictly by pre-entry `score_candidate_record_pre_entry_v1793122`
    with frozen deterministic tie-breaker `(quality_tuple, direction, model_id, opportunity_id)`.
Returns `(selected_winner_or_None, tie_lost_candidates)`.

Bitget USDT-Margined Perpetual Isolated Liquidation Price Model.
Based on official Bitget Classic Contract maintenance margin and tier rules:
Notional = Quantity * Multiplier * Entry
Initial Margin = Notional / Leverage
Maintenance Margin = Notional * MMR - Deduction

Long:
  Equity = Margin + (LP - Entry)*Q*M
  At Liquidation: Equity = MaintenanceMargin(LP) + ClosingFee
  LP_long = [Entry * Q * M - Margin - Deduction] / [Q * M * (1 - MMR - ClosingFeeRate)]

Short:
  Equity = Margin + (Entry - LP)*Q*M
  At Liquidation: Equity = MaintenanceMargin(LP) + ClosingFee
  LP_short = [Entry * Q * M + Margin + Deduction] / [Q * M * (1 + MMR + ClosingFeeRate)]

Returns (LP, InitialMargin, MaintenanceMargin, Tier, MaxTierLeverage)

Authoritative domain calculation for Risk, Reward, Sizing, Fees, Leverage, Margin and Liquidation.
Used identically across Preview, Strategy, Broker, and Journal.

Computes strict True Range Mean (SMA_TR_V1) for stop loss buffer sizing (V17.7.4).
Requires at least `period + 1` continuous, finite closed bars.
Excludes unclosed bars or future bars after as_of_ms.
Strictly synchronizes bar_duration_ms with timeframe.
Validates symbol consistency, candle closure, and positive finite prices.
Enforces active-window cadence verification (no gap bridging).

Section 4.2: Collect causal stop anchor candidates from closed M1/M5/M15 market structure.
Strictly enforces `known_at_ms <= decision_timestamp_ms` and `source_bar_close_ms <= decision_timestamp_ms`.
Distinguishes outer protected swings (`is_protected_swing=True`) from internal/local sweep extremes
(`is_local_sweep_only=True`).

Section 4.3: Deterministic ranking of causal structural stop anchor candidates.
Prioritizes:
  1. Valid causal, closed-bar, un-invalidated candidates on the protective side of entry
     within `max_stop_distance_usd`
  2. Protected swings (`is_protected_swing=True`, `is_local_sweep_only=False`) over internal/local sweep wicks
  3. Higher `structural_rank`
  4. More recent `occurred_at_ms`
  5. Deterministic tie-break by `anchor_id` ascending
Never ranks by future outcome.

Section 4.5: Derive outward tick-quantized structure-valid stop price:
  - LONG: `floor_tick(invalidation_price - noise_buffer_price)`
  - SHORT: `ceil_tick(invalidation_price + noise_buffer_price)`

Section 4.7: Resolve causal unconsumed liquidity target candidates from:
  - Provided `liquidity_pools` (M1/M5/M15/H1/H4/PDH/PDL)
  - Confirmed closed M1, M5, M15, H1, H4 swings (`known_at_ms <= decision_timestamp_ms`)
  - Completed prior-day D1 High/Low (`PDH`/`PDL` with `close_time <= decision_timestamp_ms`)
Strictly filters out consumed/swept/expired levels across all closed LTF/HTF bars, future levels,
and wrong-side levels.

Section 4.7: Select an authoritative, causal liquidity target.
  - In `BASELINE_FROZEN` mode (`A`, `B`, `C`, `D1`, `D2`): uses `baseline_target_price` / `baseline_target_id`
    so stop-loss experiments are strictly isolated from target changes.
  - In `V1792_CAUSAL_STRUCTURAL_VIABLE` mode (`D3`, `D4`, `D6`): iterates sorted causal liquidity
    target candidates (nearest to farthest) and selects the nearest causal unconsumed pool that
    achieves `net_rr >= min_net_rr` under full round-trip fees and slippage.
  - NEVER invents `TP = entry +/- k * stop_distance`.

Causally identify swing highs and swing lows for any timeframe (SECTIONS 021 - 032).
Confirmation strictly requires right_bars closed candles.
known_at_ms = confirm_open + duration_ms (when right_bars confirmation bar closes).

Section 07 (Truth Closure #1) & V17.9.3.1.2.4 Stage R3 (Fresh Regression Truth):
1. Discovers all `backend/tests/test_*.py` files in the repository (or `test_files_override`
   in isolated unit tests).
2. Runs `pytest --collect-only -q` across the discovered test suite and records all
   canonical node IDs (`24_full_pytest_collection_node_ids_manifest.json`).
3. Shards the test files across `<= 4` parallel pytest subprocesses with `--junitxml`,

When `force_fresh_execution=True` (mandatory for V17.9.3.1.2.4), deletes any pre-existing
XML files in `junit_dir` before running and forbids any XML resume shortcut.

Section 08 (Truth Closure #2 — `EXECUTABLE_RED_GREEN_TESTS`):
Executes 16 genuine source-level code mutations (`M01..M16`) inside an isolated
temporary directory copy of `services/v17_9_3_1_2_2_signal_intelligence.py` and
`services/scalp_m1_types.py`.
Each mutation runs a real Python subprocess asserting the invariant:
  - Under mutated source: subprocess exits with `red_exit_code != 0` (`caught_red = True`).
  - Under restored/unmutated source: subprocess exits with `green_exit_code == 0` (`restored_green = True`).
Never modifies the tracked working tree.
